permissionRules.rule: No row-permission declaration exists in shared/schema.ts; named queries and mutator code carry application policy.
applyIssuePermissions returns all issues only for role=crew; everyone else, including anonymous and ordinary creator, gets visibility=public.
assertUserCanSeeIssue allows public, issue creator, or crew; this is broader for an ordinary internal-issue creator than the query rule.
issue/comment/emoji edit or delete requires creatorID=JWT sub unless crew; absent and unauthorized use a generic message for non-crew.
viewState, userPref and notification mutations derive userID from JWT sub; queries filter the same principal.
projects have no visibility/member table; issue visibility is global public/internal and crew role is global, while projectName only scopes issue/label membership.
commentsPage, comment and emojiChange do not traverse to a permission-gated issue; direct ids can affect observable rows independently of issue visibility.
issue first passes the same role/public gate; only then a separate ungated comment query runs in the same transaction.
email recipients for internal issues are restricted to crew even if a non-crew creator has a subscription row; Discord is public issues only.
